verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, setting out the next command: 📣
‘Pass this word from Yahweh to Aaron, his sons, and all Israel: 📜
If any Israelite kills a bull, lamb, or goat—inside camp or out—🐂
and doesn’t bring it to the Meeting Tent entrance as an offering before Yahweh’s Tabernacle, that person has blood on their hands and must be cut off from the community. ⚠️
This is so Israel brings those open-field sacrifices to Yahweh at the Meeting Tent entrance, to the priest, and offers them there as peace offerings to Yahweh. 🕊️
The priest must splash the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the Meeting Tent entrance and burn the fat as an aroma that pleases Yahweh. 🔥
They must stop bringing offerings to goat idols—the ones they’ve been unfaithful with. This rule stands for every generation. 🚫
‘Tell them this too: If any Israelite or foreigner living among you brings a burnt offering or sacrifice, 🐑
but skips the Meeting Tent entrance instead of offering it to Yahweh, that person must be cut off from the community. ⚠️
‘If any Israelite or foreigner living among you eats blood of any kind, I will set myself against that person and cut them off from the community. 🩸
A creature’s life is in its blood. I gave you blood for the altar, to make atonement for your lives; blood makes atonement because life is in it. 🙏
That’s why I told Israel: nobody among you may eat blood—not even a foreigner living with you. 🚫
‘If an Israelite or foreigner living among you hunts an animal or bird that’s allowed as food, they must drain its blood and cover it with dirt. 🦌
Every creature’s life is in its blood. That’s why I told Israel: don’t eat any creature’s blood; its life is in there. Whoever eats it must be cut off. 🩸

‘Anyone, Israelite or foreigner, who eats an animal that died by itself or was torn apart by another animal must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and stay unclean till evening; then they’re clean. 🧼
But if they skip washing their clothes and bathing, they carry the guilt themselves.’ ⚖️
